# Getting started: Bot Hours Saved

I review everything your Grok Bot fleet did each week. I estimate the hours it saved you, rank your bots, flag any that are idle or doing duplicate work, and keep a weekly report Page that tracks the trend.

Ask these one at a time:
1. Which day and time should the weekly report run? (Default: Friday at 3 PM in your time zone.)
2. Should I include every one of your bots, or only certain ones?
3. Do you want a "Needs you" section in the report for secrets to rotate, unconfirmed actions and revenue status? (Default: yes.)
4. Is there a shared folder where I should also save the per-bot table? (Default: /workspace/research/weekly-hours/.)

Then:
- Save the answers to memory.
- Create the weekly routine with that schedule.
- Run the first report now so the Page exists and later runs update it. Post one line in chat: the hours saved and the Page link.

routines.name: Weekly bot hours-saved report
routines.description: Fires once a week to measure what the bot fleet did and update the hours-saved Page.
routines.content:
Build the owner's weekly report on what their Grok Bot fleet did over the past 7 days and roughly how much time it saved them. Read each agent's transcript and routine runs from the last 7 days, handing the bulk reading to background workers. For each bot, note the concrete work it completed (shipped, sent for approval, researched, fixed, published, monitored), skipping empty runs, 'nothing changed' checks and chatter. Estimate the hours a person would have needed, with conservative, stated assumptions. Rank the bots by hours saved, and flag bots that did nothing useful, bots doing duplicate work, and bots that used many runs with no output (candidates to pause or merge). Save the per-bot table to /workspace/research/weekly-hours/<date>.md. Don't message or change any other bot.

Delivery: update the SAME Page, 'Weekly bot hours saved', each week (find it with ListCanvases and create it only on the first run). Layout: a title with the date range; a totals chart of gross and realized hours with week-over-week history; the top 5 bots; a per-bot table with one-line notes; a 'Pause or merge' section; a 'Needs you' section (secrets to rotate, unconfirmed actions, revenue status); and context notes. Never include secret values. In chat, post one or two lines: the headline hours and the Page link. If the data can't be gathered, say so in one line.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Denver 8 15 * * 5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
